# PayStage

> Payment safety layer for agents. Small, focused MCP tools that compose into a payment
> safety layer. Three tools available now: payment preflight, auth watch, and HIP-3 trade
> preflight. A hosted pay-per-call HTTP API is live on Base Sepolia.

Not financial advice. The trade preflight tool is a local policy gate only — it does not
place orders or recommend trades.

## Tools (available now)

### `evaluate_mcp_payment`

Evaluate a proposed x402 payment against a local policy file before signing. Returns
`pay` | `review` | `do_not_pay`. Package: `@paystage/mcp` (0.2.0).

Example `policy.json`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "max_amount": { "value": "1.00", "asset": "USDC", "decimals": 6 },
  "allowed_pay_to": ["0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C"],
  "allowed_networks": ["eip155:8453", "eip155:84532"],
  "unknown_payee": "review"
}
```

### `list_outstanding_auths`

List outstanding ERC-20, Permit2, and EIP-3009 authorizations. Package:
`@paystage/auth-watch` (0.1.0).

### `evaluate_outstanding_auths`

Flag outstanding authorizations that need attention. Package: `@paystage/auth-watch`
(0.1.0).

### `evaluate_hip3_trade`

Evaluate a proposed HIP-3 / trade.xyz order against a local `TradePolicy`; returns
`allow` | `review` | `do_not_trade`. Package: `@paystage/trade-preflight` (0.1.2), also
exposed via `@paystage/mcp` (0.2.0). This is a local policy gate only — it does not place
orders or recommend trades. Not financial advice.

## Hosted pay-per-call HTTP API

A hosted pay-per-call HTTP API is live on Base Sepolia.

- Base Sepolia endpoint: https://sepolia.api.paystage.xyz
- https://api.paystage.xyz is currently still Sepolia (same testnet behavior).
- Price: $0.002 USDC per call.
- Mainnet (`eip155:8453`) on `api.paystage.xyz` is pending Coinbase CDP facilitator
  credentials. Mainnet is not yet live.

## Packages

- `@paystage/mcp` (0.2.0) — umbrella MCP server, 4 tools. `npx -y @paystage/mcp`
- `@paystage/auth-watch` (0.1.0) — outstanding-auth tools
- `@paystage/trade-preflight` (0.1.2) — HIP-3 / trade.xyz trade preflight.
  `npx -y @paystage/trade-preflight`
